prompt:
Create a close-up black-and-white high-fashion editorial portrait using the uploaded photo as the facial identity reference. Preserve the exact facial structure, hairstyle, skin texture, proportions, expression, and overall likeness from the uploaded image. Keep the same sporty wraparound dark sunglasses with reflective lenses and the same oversized high-collared black puffer garment covering the neck. 

Maintain the same clean white seamless studio background, soft high-end fashion lighting, centered composition, and minimalist aesthetic. Make only very subtle changes to the head angle (5–10°), shoulder position, and garment folds for a natural variation while keeping the image almost identical to the original. Ultra-realistic, crisp skin detail, premium magazine editorial photography, high contrast, 8K quality.

promptZh:
使用上传的照片作为面部特征参考，创作一张 黑白 的高定时尚编辑类肖像。保留上传图片中精确的面部结构、发型、皮肤纹理、比例、表情以及整体相似度。保留相同的运动风深色环绕式反光墨镜，以及遮住颈部的 超大高领黑色羽绒服。

保持相同的 干净的白色无缝摄影棚背景、柔和的高端时尚布光、居中构图以及极简主义美学。仅对头部角度（5–10°）、肩部位置和服装褶皱进行极其细微的调整，以实现自然的变体，同时保持图像与原图几乎一致。超写实，清晰的皮肤细节，顶级杂志编辑摄影，高对比度，8K 画质。
